_note: Key pickups that aren't gear, shown on the Act 1 map. x/y are in-game minimap coordinates; region is wilderness, underdark, creche, grymforge or mountain

pickups.name: Auntie Ethel's Hair
pickups.where: Defeat Auntie Ethel in her lair under the Riverside Teahouse (or take her bargain): +1 to an ability score of your choice, permanently

pickups.name: Sussur Tree
pickups.where: Sussur Bark from the tree makes the Sussur weapons, whose hits can silence spellcasters

pickups.name: Necromancy of Thay
pickups.where: In the hidden cellar of the Blighted Village apothecary; reading it fully pays off in Act 3

pickups.name: Adamantine Forge
pickups.where: Forge Adamantine armour and weapons from Mithral Ore and the moulds found in Grymforge
